manyOffline.body: Open the overview to see which.

cert.title: An agent certificate isn't renewing
cert.body: {{node}} on {{env}}: the certificate expires {{when}}. Check that the agent can reach TierPlan.
cert.bodyExpired: {{node}} on {{env}}: the certificate expired {{when}}. Check that the agent can reach TierPlan.

manualUpdate.titleStandby_one: {{count}} agent needs a manual update (standby agent)
manualUpdate.titleStandby_other: {{count}} agents need a manual update (including the standby agent)
manualUpdate.body: Auto-update is off or the agent is outside the compatibility window.

clock.title: The clock is off on {{node}}
clock.body: {{node}} on {{env}} is {{offset}} out of step. TierPlan refuses agents beyond 5 minutes.

pending.title: {{name}} still has no agent
pending.body_one: It was added {{count}} day ago. Finish installing the agent or remove it.
pending.body_other: It was added {{count}} days ago. Finish installing the agent or remove it.

clusterChanged.title: {{name}} was re-initialised
clusterChanged.body: Adopt the new cluster or remove the environment.

fold.title: This host is part of {{swarm}}
fold.body: Fold it into the swarm environment so it isn't listed twice.

gitSync.title: {{name}} can't sync with its repository
gitSync.body: {{reason}} The last good version is still running.
gitSync.manyTitle_one: {{count}} stack can't sync with its repository
gitSync.manyTitle_other: {{count}} stacks can't sync with their repositories
gitSync.manyBody: The last good versions on {{env}} are still running.

autoDeploySkipped.title: Auto-deploy of {{name}} was skipped
autoDeploySkipped.body: {{reason}} Commit {{commit}} is waiting for a fix or a manual review.

autoDeployReverted.title: {{name}} was auto-deployed and reverted drift
autoDeployReverted.body_one: {{count}} change made outside the stack was put back, for example {{example}}.
autoDeployReverted.body_other: {{count}} changes made outside the stack were put back, for example {{example}}.

autoDeployPaused.title: Auto-deploy of {{name}} is paused
autoDeployPaused.owner: {{user}} no longer has permission to deploy here.
autoDeployPaused.ownerGone: The person who set it up no longer has permission to deploy here.

git_autodeploy_skipped.body: Commits on {{env}} are waiting for a fix or a manual review.

git_autodeploy_reverted.title_one: {{count}} stack was auto-deployed and reverted drift
git_autodeploy_reverted.title_other: {{count}} stacks were auto-deployed and reverted drift
git_autodeploy_reverted.body: Changes made outside the stacks on {{env}} were put back.

git_autodeploy_paused.body: On {{env}}. Open each stack to resume or transfer it.

updateRolledBack.title: {{name}} was rolled back
updateRolledBack.body: The update to {{digest}} failed and {{name}} runs the previous version. {{environment}}.
updateRolledBack.pullBody: The image for {{digest}} couldn't be pulled, so nothing was changed. {{environment}}.
updateRolledBack.manyTitle_one: {{count}} update failed and was rolled back
updateRolledBack.manyTitle_other: {{count}} updates failed and were rolled back
updateRolledBack.manyBody: Open the services of {{environment}} to see which.

updateRollbackFailed.title: {{name}} may be partly updated
updateRollbackFailed.body: The update to {{digest}} failed and TierPlan couldn't put the previous version back. {{environment}}.

refusalBurst.description: {{user}} was refused {{count}} times in the last minute. Look at the audit log.

untrustedForwarded.title: Forwarded headers from an untrusted address
untrustedForwarded.body: TierPlan got X-Forwarded headers from {{ip}}, which isn't in TIERPLAN_TRUSTED_PROXIES. They were ignored.

urlMismatch.title: Requests don't match the public URL
urlMismatch.body: Requests arrive for {{host}} over {{scheme}}, but the public URL is {{url}}. Sign-in and agent connections may fail.

webSocketFailing.title: WebSocket connections are failing
webSocketFailing.body: Agents or terminals can't connect through your proxy. Check that it passes the Upgrade headers.

expiring.description: {{scope}} credential for {{host}}. Pulls that use it fail after that.
expiring.descriptionMany: Pulls that use them fail after that.

expired.title: “{{name}}” has expired
expired.description: {{scope}} credential for {{host}}. Pulls that use it are being refused.
expired.descriptionMany: Pulls that use them are being refused.

auth_failed.title: “{{name}}” was refused by {{host}}
auth_failed.description: Its last use failed {{time}}. Check its token or test it.
auth_failed.descriptionMany: Their last use failed. Check their tokens or test them.

fallback.title: The HTTPS certificate expired
fallback.body: The certificate expired {{when}}. TierPlan is serving its self-signed certificate instead, so browsers show a warning. Agents stay connected. Fix the cause on the HTTPS page and renew.

paused.title: Let's Encrypt is paused
paused.restore: This TierPlan was restored from a backup, so it won't issue or renew until you resume. Check that your public URL points at this install, then resume on the HTTPS page.
paused.toldToWait: Let's Encrypt asked TierPlan to wait until {{time}}. Automatic attempts continue after that. There is nothing to do.
paused.toldToWaitNoTime: Let's Encrypt asked TierPlan to wait. Automatic attempts continue after that. There is nothing to do.
paused.failureGuard: Three runs failed within an hour, so TierPlan holds back until {{time}}. Fix the cause shown on the HTTPS page, then try again.
paused.failureGuardNoTime: Three runs failed within an hour, so TierPlan holds back for now. Fix the cause shown on the HTTPS page, then try again.

clock.title: The server clock is off
clock.bodyAhead: TierPlan's clock is {{offset}} ahead of Let's Encrypt's. Expiry and renewal times follow it. Fix NTP on the TierPlan host.
clock.bodyBehind: TierPlan's clock is {{offset}} behind Let's Encrypt's. Expiry and renewal times follow it. Fix NTP on the TierPlan host.

expiring.title: The HTTPS certificate expires soon
expiring.letsEncrypt: The certificate expires {{when}} and hasn't renewed. Open the HTTPS page to see why.
expiring.letsEncryptExpired: The certificate expired {{when}} and hasn't renewed. Open the HTTPS page to see why.
expiring.certFiles: The certificate files expire {{when}}. TierPlan never renews them. Replace the files and it picks the new ones up within a minute.
expiring.certFilesExpired: The certificate files expired {{when}}. TierPlan never renews them. Replace the files and it picks the new ones up within a minute.
expiring.other: The certificate expires {{when}}. Open the HTTPS page to replace it.
expiring.otherExpired: The certificate expired {{when}}. Open the HTTPS page to replace it.

txtLeft.title: A DNS record was left behind
txtLeft.body: TierPlan couldn't delete {{record}} from your Cloudflare zone. It keeps trying. If it stays, delete the record in Cloudflare.
txtLeft.bodyPaused: TierPlan couldn't delete {{record}} from your Cloudflare zone. It tries again once Let's Encrypt is running. If it stays, delete the record in Cloudflare.

unknownAgents.title_one: {{count}} agent isn't known to this TierPlan
unknownAgents.title_other: {{count}} agents aren't known to this TierPlan
unknownAgents.description_one: It was installed after the backup you restored.
unknownAgents.description_other: They were installed after the backup you restored.

render.title: Proxy configuration not updated
render.body: TierPlan couldn't render the proxy configuration for {{route}}: {{reason}}. The proxy keeps serving its last working configuration.
render.bodyNoRoute: TierPlan couldn't render an environment's proxy configuration: {{reason}}. The proxy keeps serving its last working configuration.

reason.ingress_render_unsafe_value: a value in the route holds a brace or backtick, which the proxy configuration can't carry
reason.ingress_render_strip_root: the route strips the root path, which would remove every path
reason.ingress_render_template_delimiter: the generated configuration holds two opening braces, which the proxy would run as a template
reason.ingress_render_name_collision: two routes would get the same name in the proxy configuration
reason.ingress_render_read_failed: TierPlan couldn't read the routes or certificates
reason.ingress_schema_unsupported: the proxy and this TierPlan share no configuration format

expiring.title: Certificate expires soon
expiring.bodyAcme: The certificate for {{hostname}} expires on {{date}} and has not renewed.
expiring.bodyAcmeUrgent: The certificate for {{hostname}} expires on {{date}} and still has not renewed. Visitors get a certificate error after that.
expiring.bodyUpload: The uploaded certificate for {{hostname}} expires on {{date}}. TierPlan never renews an uploaded certificate, so upload a new one before then.
expiring.bodyUploadUrgent: The uploaded certificate for {{hostname}} expires on {{date}}. TierPlan never renews an uploaded certificate, so upload a new one now, or visitors get a certificate error.

renewalFailed.title: A certificate couldn't be renewed
renewalFailed.body: The certificate for {{hostname}} couldn't be renewed: {{reason}}.
renewalFailed.bodyStaging: The staging (test) certificate for {{hostname}} failed: {{reason}}. It is a test certificate and is never served.

paused.title: Certificates are paused
paused.restore: This TierPlan was restored from a backup, so it won't order or renew certificates until an instance admin resumes them.
paused.other: TierPlan isn't ordering or renewing certificates until an instance admin resumes them.

class.rate_limited: the certificate authority is limiting requests
class.validation_unreachable: the certificate authority couldn't reach the host
class.validation_dns: the certificate authority couldn't look up the host's DNS records
class.validation_txt: the challenge record wasn't found in DNS
class.caa_forbids: a CAA record doesn't allow this certificate authority
class.identifier_rejected: the certificate authority won't issue for this hostname
class.contact_invalid: the ACME account's contact email was rejected
class.tos_action_required: the certificate authority needs its terms accepted again
class.account_gone: the ACME account is no longer known
class.ca_unavailable: the certificate authority had an error
class.ca_untrusted: the certificate authority's certificate isn't trusted
class.dns_token_invalid: the DNS provider refused the domain's token
class.dns_token_scope: the domain's token can't edit DNS records
class.dns_zone_not_found: the token can't see the DNS zone
class.dns_delegation_target: the challenge name is delegated to a zone TierPlan can't edit
class.dns_not_visible: the challenge record didn't appear in DNS in time
class.dns_rate_limited: the DNS provider is limiting changes
class.dns_unavailable: the DNS provider couldn't be reached

noHolder.title: No node holds the virtual IP on {{env}}
noHolder.body: No node holds {{address}}, so ingress doesn't answer on it. This began {{time}}. Check that a proxy is ready on at least one node.

multipleHolders.title: More than one node holds the virtual IP on {{env}}
multipleHolders.body_other: {{count}} nodes all report holding {{address}}. The nodes probably can't hear each other. Check that multicast traffic passes between them on the network.

moved.title: The virtual IP moved on {{env}}
moved.titleMany_other: The virtual IP moved {{count}} times on {{env}}
moved.bodyMany: The latest move was from {{from}} to {{to}} {{time}}. {{reason}}

reason.probe_failing: The previous holder's proxy stopped answering.

foreignRouter.title: Another router uses the virtual IP's router ID on {{env}}
foreignRouter.body: Something on the network sends virtual router adverts with router ID {{routerId}} that this swarm's key doesn't match. Change this swarm's router ID, or find the other router.
foreignRouter.bodySender: {{sender}} sends virtual router adverts with router ID {{routerId}} that this swarm's key doesn't match. Change this swarm's router ID, or find that device.

clock.title: The clock is off on {{node}}, which the virtual IP needs
clock.body: {{node}} on {{env}} is {{offset}} out of step. The virtual IP rejects adverts more than {{window}} old, so the nodes may stop hearing each other. Fix the clock on that node.
clock.bodyNoOffset: {{node}} on {{env}} is rejecting adverts as too old, so its clock is out of step. The virtual IP can't stay up while that lasts. Fix the clock on that node.

privilegedLost.title: The virtual IP can't be managed on {{env}}
privilegedLost.body_one: The agent on {{node}} no longer allows privileged services. The virtual IP keeps running, but TierPlan can't change or repair it until every manager's agent allows them again.
privilegedLost.body_other: {{count}} managers' agents no longer allow privileged services. The virtual IP keeps running, but TierPlan can't change or repair it until every manager's agent allows them again.
